result.summary: The image shows a residential street with two travel lanes and a dedicated bike lane. While sidewalks are present, there is a notable lack of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures to support safe crossing in this residential context.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, requiring pedestrians to cross unprotected across multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to provide designated and visible crossing points for residents.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, multi-lane roadway with residential and commercial land uses but lacks any visible crossing infrastructure. While a sidewalk is present, it is narrow and lacks a buffer from traffic, creating a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks or signals for pedestrians to cross the multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with continental striping to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines.

result.summary: The environment features a well-marked continental crosswalk and a dedicated bike lane on the main thoroughfare. While sidewalks are in good condition, dense vegetation at the corner creates potential sightline obstructions between motorists and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Vegetation Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense trees at the corner of the intersection may block the view of pedestrians for drivers turning from the side street.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the crosswalk entrance

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Side Street Approach
hazards.description: No stop sign or yield sign is clearly visible for the side street approach, potentially leading to conflicts at the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Side street approach to the main road

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove low-hanging branches and vegetation near the crosswalk to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Yield to Pedestrian' signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk and clarify right-of-way.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked crosswalk and continuous sidewalks, providing basic connectivity. However, the crossing is uncontrolled and lacks warning signage or traffic calming measures to manage vehicle speeds at the intersection.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks a stop sign, traffic signal, or flashing beacon to facilitate safe crossing across two lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Warning Signage
hazards.description: There are no visible signs alerting approaching drivers to the presence of a pedestrian crossing near the institutional building.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility W11-2 pedestrian crossing signs with diagonal downward pointing arrows to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install user-actuated RRFBs to significantly increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.
